ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
<image>In $\odot S, m \angle T S R=42$
Find $m\widehat{KT}$
ready1_open_rewrite.title: Geometry3K open-ended question

ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure is a circle centered at S, with four points T, R, K, E marked on the circle. A line segment goes from R through S to K, showing that R, S, K are collinear; there is also a radius from T to S. The problem gives m∠TSR = 42. Reasoning: Because S is the center of the circle, and R, S, K are collinear, RK is a diameter, and SR and SK are opposite rays. Therefore ∠TSR and ∠TSK form a pair of linear angles, m∠TSK = 180 - 42 = 138. ∠TSK is the central angle intercepting arc KT, so m arc KT = 138.

method.method_draft: Read the diagram first: S is the center of circle S, and the drawn segments show R, S, K are collinear, so RK is a diameter; T is another point on the circle. From the text, m∠TSR = 42. Since SR and SK are opposite rays on the same diameter, ∠TSR and ∠TSK form a linear pair, so m∠TSK = 180 - 42 = 138. Because ∠TSK is a central angle intercepting arc KT, m arc KT = 138.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：图中是一个以 S 为中心的圆，圆上标有 T、R、K、E 四点。线段从 R 经过 S 到 K，显示 R、S、K 共线；另有从 T 到 S 的半径。题目给出 m∠TSR = 42。推理：因为 S 是圆心，且 R、S、K 共线，所以 RK 是直径，SR 与 SK 是相反射线。因此 ∠TSR 和 ∠TSK 构成一组线性角，m∠TSK = 180 - 42 = 138。∠TSK 是截弧 KT 的圆心角，所以 m弧KT = 138。

method.method_draft: Read the diagram first: points K and R are endpoints of a diameter through center S, so the arc from K to R along the left/top side is a semicircle measuring 180 degrees. The point T lies on that same semicircle between K and R. From the text, m∠TSR = 42, and since it is a central angle, it gives m arc TR = 42. Therefore m arc KT = m arc KR semicircle - m arc TR = 180 - 42 = 138.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中是圆 S，S 标在圆心位置。点 K 和 R 在圆上，并且线段 KSR 是一条经过圆心 S 的直线，所以 KR 是直径。点 T 也在圆上，位于从 K 到 R 的左上半圆弧上，且给出中心角 ∠TSR = 42°。
推理：因为 ∠TSR 的顶点是圆心 S，所以它是中心角，对应的小弧 TR 的度数等于 42°。由于 KR 是直径，弧 KR 是半圆，度数为 180°。在该半圆上，弧 KR 由弧 KT 和弧 TR 组成，所以 m弧KT = 180° - 42° = 138°。

planner_metadata.distinctiveness_rationale: This route avoids first finding ∠KST explicitly; it treats the desired arc as the remainder of a semicircle after subtracting the known intercepted arc TR.
planner_metadata.image_role: Identify RK as a diameter through S and see that T lies on the semicircular arc from K to R, splitting it into arcs KT and TR.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the given central angle m∠TSR = 42 and the request for m arc KT.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use that a diameter subtends a semicircle of 180 degrees, and that a central angle equals the measure of its intercepted arc.
